title: Grateful Dead Live at Cleveland Public Hall on 1973-12-06

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show featuring the legendary China>Rider transitional jam, captured on a partial soundboard but marred by noticeable splice edits.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the extraordinary China Cat Sunflower into Rider segue, calling it the best of its kind, and also praise the Dark Star > Eyes stretch. The recording is a partial sound‑board source that sounds clear overall, yet several reviewers note jarring splices that break what should be seamless jams.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers rate the show highly (5 and 4 stars) and focus on the musical brilliance, but the splice issues in the recording lower the overall score slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Partial soundboard capture; clear overall but contains audible splices that interrupt seamless jams (China>Rider, Dark Star).

show_quality.setlist_flow: Exceptional transitional jam between China and Rider praised; however splices in the recording disrupt what should be a fluid flow.
